videos.headline: Highlight: Madison Booker's historic 40-point night powers Texas past Oregon
videos.description: Booker scores 40, the most by a Longhorn in NCAA Tournament history and the highest total in this year's tournament, as 1-seed Texas rolls past 8-seed Oregon, 100-58, into the Sweet Sixteen.

videos.headline: Madison Booker explains how she is dominating in her roll for Texas
